authorization.generation: Owner rejected the leaf study and approved a skeuomorphic full-square material surface referencing Dotty's construction on 2026-11-05.
authorization.acceptance: Owner said to use this direction and continue; exact-byte owner review remains separate from R2 upload and website publication.
authorization.publication: R2 upload and website publication are separate from generation and review.

description.en: Shallow frame, note, brush and connector impressions form a distributed working surface.
description.zh: 圆角框、便签、笔触与连接点的浅压痕铺满整张工作面。

design.motif: Staggered rounded frame outlines, sticky-note corners, tapered brush channels, connector anchors and faint snapping-grid traces pressed into one matte sheet.
design.rationale: The owner classified Mico as skeuomorphic and requested Dotty-level full-square coverage. Mico's own canvas tools supply the geometry instead of Dotty's ceramic contours.

purpose.en: A local-first canvas where people and AI agents create together
purpose.zh: 面向人与 AI Agent 协作创作的本地画布
